item.title: About Us
item.description:
The Lake

Kembattahalli Lake is located in the Kembattahalli village, Uttarahalli hobli, Bangalire South Taluk / JP Nagar 8th phase of Bengaluru, Karnataka. It spans approximately 6+ acres and serves as a crucial water recharge zone for the surrounding region. It is a vital water body in our community, supporting local biodiversity. The lake rejuvenation project is a community effort involving local residents, environmentalists, and government officials.

It all began with a few concerned residents who noticed the steady decline of Kembattahalli Lake. Encroachment, pollution, and neglect had taken a toll on what was once a thriving water body.

item.title: Lake Restoration

item.title: Tree Plantation Drive
item.description:
We are creating a green buffer zone around Kembattahalli Lake by planting native tree species.

Why Trees?

Trees play a vital role in lake conservation — they prevent soil erosion, improve groundwater recharge, provide habitat for wildlife, and enhance the beauty of the area.

Our Goal

Plant 1000+ native trees around the lake perimeter and surrounding areas, creating a self-sustaining green belt.

Get Involved

Join our next tree plantation drive! Check our events page for upcoming dates.

item.title: Volunteer With Us
item.description:
Volunteers are the backbone of our initiative. Here’s how you can contribute your time and skills.

Ways to Volunteer

  • Clean-Up Drives: Join our weekend clean-up events at the lake.
  • Tree Plantation: Help us plant and maintain native trees.
  • Awareness Campaigns: Spread the word about lake conservation.
  • Skill-Based Volunteering: Offer your expertise in areas like legal, communication, GIS mapping, or project management.

Sign Up

Interested? Send us an email at welfare.kembattahalli.lake@gmail.com with your name, area of interest, and availability. We’ll get back to you with upcoming opportunities.
